title: Year of the Tiger: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Bold, magnetic, and fiercely independent, those born in the Year of the Tiger live life on their own terms. Whether you were born in 1950, 1986, 2010, or 2022, understanding this powerful zodiac sign unlocks the secrets to your natural charisma.
personality: Tigers are natural-born leaders endowed with boundless energy, courage, and an irresistible personal magnetism. Never one to blend into the background, a Tiger approaches the world with a sense of adventure and an unwavering commitment to justice. They possess a generous heart and will fiercely defend the underdog, earning them deep respect from friends and peers alike. While their confidence is inspiring, Tigers can sometimes be impulsive, quick-tempered, and prone to making hasty decisions when fueled by emotion. Beneath their roaring, fearless exterior lies a deeply sensitive soul that values authenticity above all else. They despise being controlled and prefer blazing their own trails rather than following a crowded path. When a Tiger sets their mind on a goal, their sheer determination and optimism almost always pave the way to success, making them unforgettable presences in any room they enter.
love: In romance, Tigers are passionate, loyal, and intensely devoted partners. They love with their whole heart and bring a sense of thrilling spontaneity to relationships. However, their fierce independence means they also require personal space and freedom to roam. Partners who try to clip their wings will quickly find the Tiger pulling away. Once a Tiger commits for the long haul, they are fiercely protective and deeply affectionate, turning their home into a warm, safe sanctuary.
career: In the professional sphere, Tigers thrive in dynamic, high-stakes environments where they can take charge. They make exceptional entrepreneurs, leaders, explorers, and creatives. Because they detest routine and micromanagement, Tigers do best when entrusted with autonomy. Their fearless approach to risk-taking often yields massive rewards, though they must learn to temper impulsivity with careful strategic planning.

faq.q: What years are associated with the Tiger?

faq.ans: The Tiger is traditionally associated with the Wood element in Chinese astrology, enhancing creativity and growth.
Tigers and Monkeys generally struggle with compatibility due to their clashing personalities and competitive natures.
